key_insight: InfiniteWeb automatically generates realistic, multi‑page, functional web environments at scale so GUI agents can be trained and evaluated without costly manual site creation. It combines large language models with programmatic scaffolding and automated validation to produce interconnected websites, not just isolated pages.
problem_solved: Lack of abundant, diverse, and realistic multi‑page web environments prevents robust training and evaluation of GUI agents — LLMs can make single pages but struggle to produce coherent, functional websites with navigation, state, and backend behavior.
method: Hierarchical generation: high‑level site planning plus page‑level LLM synthesis to ensure coherent multi‑page structure and consistent content.
Programmatic scaffolding and mock backend: automatically add routing, state management, forms, and simulated APIs so pages behave like real sites.
Automated validation and diversification: run scripted playthroughs and checks to verify functionality and generate many variants for scale and coverage.
impact: Enables large‑scale, diverse synthetic web datasets that accelerate training, benchmarking, and generalization of GUI agents while cutting manual environment creation time and cost. This unlocks more realistic agent behaviors and faster iteration for UI automation research.
